title: Replacement extension.
officialText:
Subject to the approval of the code enforcement official, the time period for
completion of the permanent barrier may be extended for good cause, including, but not limited to, adverse weather
conditions delaying construction.
SECTION BC 3110
AUTOMATIC VEHICULAR GATES
